title: Eyes with basic dorsal and specific ventral regions in the glacial Apollo, Parnassius glacialis (Papilionidae)
why: Parnassius, acuity_cpd and interommatidial_deg: a study of the compound eye of the glacial Apollo, P. glacialis, a congener of the queue's P. apollo. The stored abstract reports four opsins localized in the retina, ommatidial heterogeneity and a dorso-ventral regionalization of the eye, so the full text may give facet or ommatidial dimensions, a count of ommatidia or an interommatidial angle from which acuity can be worked out (a congener's value would close the cell as g under carry rule 3). It came back for the harvest query "Parnassius vision". The acuity pair ("Parnassius visual acuity"; "Apollo butterfly visual acuity") returned this paper's journal page, the PMC copy of the 2012 rhabdom study, SOKENDAI repository records (3259, with a PDF of the 2010 paper, and 3991), the 2012 conference abstract, Turku records of the larval host-location study, Caves et al. 2023 on bird acuity, the Wikipedia article and patents. Main holds no row from it. Title, year, journal and DOI from the harvest output; not opened.

title: Morphological traits of the eyes of Lepidoptera indicate selection for binocular vision in both diurnal butterflies and nocturnal moths
why: acuity_cpd and interommatidial_deg of Polygrammate and Parnassius: an eye-model study of 2,730 specimens representing 224 butterfly and moth species (stored abstract in the harvest output of Lycaena, which lists it; the harvests of these two genera do not), whose species table main has not read, so a species of these genera may be among them. It is outside the canon file, so these traits stay out of this unit's search records, as the desk held the Lepidoptera acuity cells of harvest-43 and harvest-46 on the same work. The acuity web pairs for the two genera returned no Polygrammate eye study ("Polygrammate visual acuity"; "Hebrew moth visual acuity": human acuity pages, patents, and compound-eye studies of Histia flabellicornis, Empoasca onukii and hawkmoths) and, for Parnassius, the two glacial Apollo eye studies that have wanted lines of their own.
